title: Composite CRT Coprime Modulus (q = 2^t * p) Bezout Phase Splitting and Factor Annihilation
claims: Over a composite modulus q = 2^t * p (p odd prime), the CRT Bezout idempotents e_1 = p*(p^{-1} mod 2^t) and e_2 = 2^t*((2^t)^{-1} mod p) factorize exp(2*pi*i a s / q) into independent dyadic Z_{2^t} and odd-prime Z_p phases.

Witnesses satisfying A v == 0 (mod p) completely annihilate the Z_p secret component s_2 (zero cross-factor leakage), while witnesses satisfying A w == 0 (mod 2^t) completely annihilate the Z_{2^t} component s_1.
favorable_controls: Composite moduli q = 12 (4x3), q = 24 (8x3), and q = 40 (8x5)
